grain.name: Sack of grain
grain.description: Four galley ingredient portions. Cheap on fertile islands.

beans.name: Dried beans
beans.description: Two galley ingredient portions; keeps well on a voyage.

fruit.name: Basket of island fruit
fruit.description: Two ready-to-eat crew portions. No spoilage model yet.

dried_fish.name: Salted fish
dried_fish.description: Two galley ingredient portions from the coastal fisheries.

biscuit.name: Ship's biscuit
biscuit.description: One ready-to-eat portion; no cooking required.

water_cask.name: Sealed water keg
water_cask.description: Ten fresh-water servings. Allocate at the ship's hold.

timber.name: Timber bundle
timber.description: Rough repair timber: one standardized construction/patching bundle; mass follows the ship material unit.

planks.name: Sawn plank bundle
planks.description: Two standardized repair/construction material charges; mass follows the ship material unit.

iron.name: Iron ingot
iron.description: Industrial export commodity. Local metalworking recipes are not implemented yet.

coal.name: Bag of coal
coal.description: Industrial fuel commodity; not yet consumed by ship stations.

shot.name: Cannon shot
shot.description: One standardized ammunition charge for cannon loading or firearm practice.

sailcloth.name: Bolt of sailcloth
sailcloth.description: Woven export commodity. Sail fabrication is not implemented yet.

rope.name: Coiled rope
rope.description: Issued rigging rope: 12% faster rigging work.

work_shirt.name: Linen work clothes
work_shirt.description: Comfortable working clothes: 15% less physical fatigue from work.

oilskin.name: Oilskin working coat
oilskin.description: 25% less work fatigue. Weather protection is not simulated yet.

cutlass.name: Sailor's cutlass
cutlass.description: Arms-drill equipment; improves boredom and weapon practice. Combat is not implemented.

flintlock.name: Flintlock pistol
flintlock.description: Firearm drills consume one ship shot charge. Combat is not implemented.
